subject: Portal profile authority & evidence transfer — BrightCore Health
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@brightcore.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: transfer Vendr profile ownership + SIG evidence package

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

We're wrapping up procurement on the BrightCore -> Redwood integration and need to transfer primary ownership for our Vendr security profile to your team so BrightCore can finalize the SIG and CAIQ crosswalk. Our procurement team is also asking for a brief evidence handoff (syslog examples + SOC2 excerpt).

Can you confirm who at Redwood should be listed as the profile owner in Vendr and the best place to upload the requested artifacts? If you prefer, we can add Redwood as a delegated steward and leave BrightCore as root owner for now.

Attachments: BrightCore_SIG_v2.pdf (pdf, 2.1MB) — current SIG export; saml-mapping.csv (csv) — suggested attribute mapping for SSO.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Sr. IT Risk Manager | BrightCore Health
lenao@brightcore.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@brightcore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: transfer Vendr profile ownership + SIG evidence package

Lena — thanks for the packet. We can take delegated stewardship in Vendr to accelerate the CAIQ/SIG exchange, then formalize ownership once procurement completes. Two quick asks: 

1) Can Vendr temporary owner be set to security@redwood.ai (we'll use a team alias) so we can upload the evidence and answer Qs?
2) We need a short list of 3 priority evidence items BrightCore wants Redwood to host (e.g., SOC2 report excerpt, SAML metadata proof, syslog sample). Uploading everything slows verification.

Marissa / Ben — FYI. Marissa, can you and Ben take point on the Vendr upload if the alias above is acceptable? I can drive the CAIQ mapping after we see the SIG export.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@brightcore.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2025 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr: how to delegate stewardship for profile BRIGHTCORE-456

Hi Karthik / Lena,

Thanks for the note — you can delegate stewardship via the profile settings (Settings > Team > Delegated Owners). Steps we recommend: 

- Add security@redwood.ai as a Delegated Owner (role: "Evidence Manager")
- Grant "Upload evidence" and "Answer questionnaire" perms only
- Use the temporary token option for uploads if you plan to script bulk ingestion (token valid 24 hours)

We also attached a small CSV template for SAML attribute mapping (saml-mapping.csv). When you add the alias, please send the profile link and we'll move the profile into "Ingest" status so your uploads skip manual QC.

Attachment: saml-mapping.csv (template)

— Vendr Support

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@brightcore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, support@vendr.com
Date: Wed, 10 Dec 2025 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: transfer Vendr profile ownership + SIG evidence package

Lena — confirmed. We added security@redwood.ai as Delegated Owner in Vendr and uploaded the three priority artifacts you suggested: 

- SOC2_Sysdesc_excerpt.pdf (redacted)
- SAML_metadata_signed.xml (signed entity metadata)
- sample_syslog_redacted.log

Uploads are live at: https://vendr.example.com/profiles/BRIGHTCORE-456 (private while in Ingest mode). We also left the BrightCore_SIG_v2.pdf in the "source artifacts" folder for reference.

Next steps: 
- Lena: once procurement confirms the final contract, we'll transfer canonical ownership to the Redwood security alias (or BrightCore can remain canonical owner per your preference).
- Marissa / Ben: please keep QA window to 48 hours and flag any CAIQ mismatches — I can take the first pass on mapping.

Thanks everyone — good momentum here.

— Karthik
Director, Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachment: upload_manifest.json (manifest of uploaded files)
